extractedText: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) — Step 2 CK primer. Epidemiology ~5-6/1000 adults/yr. Typical: S. pneumoniae, H. influenzae, Moraxella. Atypical: Mycoplasma, Chlamydophila, Legionella. CXR confirms. CURB-65 / PSI stratify. Tx: outpatient amoxicillin/macrolide; inpatient beta-lactam + macrolide; ICU adds anti-MRSA/Pseudomonas if risk. Complications: empyema, abscess, sepsis, ARDS.
